title: Product Manager, AI & App Experience
description:
Product Manager, AI & App Experience

Manchester · Hybrid, 2 days on-site · Circa £60,000–£85,000 depending on experience



About the role

We’re recruiting a Product Manager to shape how AI is used across a consumer app. This is a newly created role with ownership of the AI product vision, strategy and roadmap, starting with an in-app AI assistant and expanding into other key areas of the app.

You’ll own the assistant from discovery through launch and ongoing improvement. You’ll decide where AI can help users make better decisions or take action, how the assistant should connect with other tools and services, and how to measure whether it’s making a difference. You’ll work closely with engineering, data science, design and research to turn ideas into simple, useful experiences that keep users informed and in control.



What you’ll do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for AI-powered experiences across the app, starting with the AI assistant.
  • Use customer research, product data and business goals to decide what to build and explain the trade-offs behind your priorities.
  • Work with engineering, data science, design and research to develop, launch and improve features such as personalised insights, recommendations and actions.
  • Define what success looks like and use experiments to measure customer outcomes and AI quality.
  • Make sure users understand what the AI is doing and can control the actions it takes on their behalf.
  • Work with Compliance, Risk and Legal to ensure features deliver fair outcomes, including for customers in vulnerable circumstances.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, decisions and progress.


What you’ll bring

Essential

  • Around three years or more of experience building consumer mobile or web products, including taking a new product or feature from idea to launch.
  • Hands-on experience delivering AI or machine learning features such as personalisation, recommendations or automation.
  • Strong product judgement and the ability to make complex technology feel simple for users.
  • A track record of improving customer outcomes through experimentation, analytics and user research.
  • Confidence working with engineers, designers and data specialists, as well as Compliance, Risk and Legal teams.
  • The ability to bring clarity and direction when priorities and requirements are still taking shape.

Desirable

  • Experience with LLM-powered products, AI assistants or AI quality evaluations.
  • Experience building products that help users change habits or work towards a goal.
  • Experience in a regulated consumer business or designing for underserved customers.

If you’ve taken an AI-powered feature from idea to launch and want to shape how AI is used across a consumer app, we’d like to hear from you.
